title: OPD timings and consultation fees, Baner branch (Pune)
text: This page covers the outpatient department (OPD) at the Varunika Hospitals Baner branch in Pune. OPD timings: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 8:00 pm. On Sundays only the general medicine and paediatrics OPDs run, from 10:00 am to 1:00 pm. The OPD is closed on 26 January, 15 August and on Lakshmi Puja day during Diwali; the Emergency department stays open. Consultation fees at Baner: general medicine and paediatrics ₹700; specialist consultations (orthopaedics, gynaecology, ENT, dermatology, ophthalmology, general surgery, psychiatry) ₹1,000; super-specialist consultations (cardiology, neurology, nephrology, gastroenterology, medical oncology) ₹1,500. A one-time registration fee of ₹150 is charged on the first visit and creates your hospital ID card, which is valid at both branches. Senior citizens aged 65 and above get 10% off the consultation fee on showing age proof; the discount does not apply to video consultations or health check packages. Walk-ins at Baner: walk-in tokens are issued only for general medicine and paediatrics, from the OPD reception, until 6:30 pm. Specialist and super-specialist consultations at Baner are by prior appointment only, booked through the call centre, the app or WhatsApp. A walk-in patient who asks for a specialist is offered the next available appointment slot, which may be on a later day. Patients with chest pain, breathlessness, a fresh injury or heavy bleeding should go straight to the Emergency department on the ground floor, which needs no appointment. Payment at the OPD billing counter is by cash, UPI, debit card or credit card.

title: OPD timings and consultation fees, Gangapur Road branch (Nashik)
text: This page covers the outpatient department (OPD) at the Varunika Hospitals Gangapur Road branch in Nashik. OPD timings: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 7:00 pm. There is no Sunday OPD at Nashik; on Sundays and on 26 January, 15 August and Lakshmi Puja day only the Emergency department is open. Consultation fees at Nashik: general medicine and paediatrics ₹600; specialist consultations (orthopaedics, gynaecology, ENT, dermatology, ophthalmology, general surgery) ₹900; super-specialist consultations (cardiology, neurology, nephrology) ₹1,300. Gastroenterology and medical oncology are not offered at Nashik; patients are referred to the Baner branch in Pune. Psychiatry at Nashik is available only as a video consultation. A one-time registration fee of ₹100 is charged on the first visit at Nashik; patients already registered at Baner do not pay it again. Senior citizens aged 65 and above get 10% off the consultation fee on showing age proof. Walk-ins at Nashik: walk-in tokens are issued for all OPD specialities until 5:00 pm, subject to the doctor's availability that day. Patients with an appointment are seen first and walk-in tokens are called in between, so the wait for walk-ins can be one to two hours on Mondays. Patients with chest pain, breathlessness, a fresh injury or heavy bleeding should go straight to the Emergency department, which is open 24 hours and needs no appointment. Payment at the OPD billing counter is by cash, UPI, debit card or credit card.

title: Appointments, cancellations and free follow-up visits
text: These rules apply to OPD appointments at both Varunika Hospitals branches (Baner, Pune and Gangapur Road, Nashik). Booking: appointments can be booked through the call centre on 020 4719 2200 (7:00 am to 10:00 pm, all days), through the Varunika app, or on WhatsApp. Appointments can be booked up to 14 days ahead. App and WhatsApp bookings are prepaid; call-centre bookings can be paid at the OPD counter on the day. Please arrive 20 minutes before your slot for registration and vitals. Late arrival: if you arrive more than 15 minutes after your slot, you are moved to the end of that doctor's queue for the day. Cancellation and refunds: you can cancel or reschedule free of charge up to 24 hours before your slot, and a prepaid fee is refunded in full to the original payment mode within 5 working days. If you cancel within 24 hours of the slot, a cancellation fee of ₹200 is deducted from the refund. If you do not turn up and do not cancel, the full consultation fee is forfeited. Each appointment can be rescheduled free of charge once, if done more than 24 hours before the slot. Free follow-up: a follow-up visit is free only within 5 days of the paid consultation, counting the day after the consultation as day 1. The free follow-up must be with the same doctor at the same branch and covers one visit only. From day 6 onwards, the full consultation fee applies. Video consultations do not carry a free follow-up. Follow-up visits still need an appointment; please mention that it is a follow-up when booking so the fee is waived.

title: Video consultations (teleconsultation)
text: Varunika Hospitals offers video consultations through the Varunika app for patients anywhere in India. Slots run every day from 8:00 am to 10:00 pm. Fees: general medicine and paediatrics ₹500; specialist video consultations (dermatology, gynaecology, ENT, psychiatry, orthopaedics follow-ups) ₹800. Super-specialist doctors (cardiology, neurology, nephrology, gastroenterology, oncology) take video consultations only for their existing patients, at ₹1,000. The fee is paid in the app at the time of booking, and the senior citizen discount does not apply. How it works: upload any previous reports and prescriptions in the app before the call. You will get a video link 10 minutes before your slot. If the doctor has not joined within 15 minutes of the slot time, you can choose a full refund, credited within 3 working days, or a free rebooking. If you miss the call yourself, the fee is not refunded. After the call, the e-prescription appears in the app within 2 hours. Doctors cannot prescribe narcotic or psychotropic medicines by video, and fitness certificates and sick-leave certificates are not issued on video consultations; these need an in-person visit. Video consultations are not for emergencies. For chest pain, breathlessness, fits, heavy bleeding or a serious injury, go to the nearest emergency department or call our 24-hour emergency line on 020 4719 2299. You will need a phone or laptop with a camera, a stable internet connection, and a quiet, well-lit place. Video consultations do not include a free follow-up.

title: Essential Health Check package
text: The Essential Health Check is the basic preventive health check at Varunika Hospitals, available at both the Baner (Pune) and Gangapur Road (Nashik) branches. Price: ₹2,499 per person. What is included: complete blood count (CBC), fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, lipid profile, liver function test, kidney function test (creatinine, urea, uric acid), thyroid stimulating hormone (TSH), urine routine, chest X-ray, resting ECG, and a consultation with a physician. Not included: treadmill test (TMT), 2D echo, vitamin D, vitamin B12 and ultrasound, which are part of the Executive Health Check. Timings: reporting time is 7:30 am to 10:30 am, Monday to Saturday, by prior booking only. You must come after a 12-hour fast; plain water is allowed. The visit takes about 3 hours. Reports: the full report is uploaded to the Varunika app within 48 hours of the visit, and a printed file can be collected from the health check desk after that. The physician consultation is done on a separate visit, after the reports are ready, and must be used within 15 days of the check. Booking: book through the call centre or the app at least one day in advance. Cancellation up to 24 hours before the slot is free; after that, ₹300 is deducted. Add-ons can be booked at the counter on the day: vitamin D ₹900, vitamin B12 ₹700, ultrasound abdomen ₹1,400. Women can add a Pap smear for ₹800. The senior citizen discount does not apply to health check packages.

title: Executive Health Check package
text: The Executive Health Check is the comprehensive preventive health check at Varunika Hospitals, available only at the Baner branch in Pune. Price: ₹5,999 per person, or ₹10,999 for two people booked together for the same day. What is included: everything in the Essential Health Check (CBC, fasting blood sugar, HbA1c, lipid profile, liver and kidney function tests, TSH, urine routine, chest X-ray, resting ECG) plus a treadmill test (TMT), 2D echo, vitamin D, vitamin B12, ultrasound abdomen, pulmonary function test, an eye check and a dental check. Consultations: on the same day, with a physician, a cardiologist and a dietitian. Timings: reporting time is 7:30 am to 9:30 am, Monday to Saturday, by prior booking only, at least two days in advance. You must come after a 12-hour fast; plain water is allowed. Breakfast is served after the fasting samples are taken. Wear comfortable shoes for the treadmill test. The visit takes about 5 hours. Reports: same-day reports are handed over at the final physician consultation, usually by 5:00 pm. Reports that need more time, such as any add-on culture tests, are uploaded to the app later. Cancellation up to 48 hours before the slot is free; after that, ₹500 is deducted. People with a known heart condition should tell the call centre when booking, as the cardiologist may replace the treadmill test with another test. The senior citizen discount does not apply.

title: Lab sample collection and report turnaround times
text: The Varunika Hospitals laboratory serves both branches. Sample collection hours at the collection centres in Baner and Nashik: Monday to Saturday 7:00 am to 9:00 pm, and Sunday 7:00 am to 12:00 pm. Fasting samples are collected only until 11:00 am. Report turnaround times, counted from sample collection: complete blood count and blood sugar within 4 hours; lipid profile, liver function and kidney function tests the same day by 7:00 pm if the sample is given before 11:00 am, otherwise the next day; HbA1c and thyroid tests the next day by 12:00 pm; vitamin D and vitamin B12 within 48 hours; urine and blood culture reports within 72 hours, with a final report up to 5 days if the culture grows bacteria; biopsy (histopathology) reports in 7 working days. Reports are sent as an SMS link and appear in the Varunika app. One printed copy is free at the report counter, open 8:00 am to 8:00 pm; each reprint costs ₹50. Home sample collection is available within Pune and Nashik city limits, from 6:30 am to 11:00 am, all days. The home collection charge is ₹250 per visit, waived when the test bill is ₹2,000 or more. Home collection must be booked by 8:00 pm the day before through the call centre or the app. The phlebotomist carries an ID card and collects payment by UPI or card at the time of collection. Reports for home collection samples follow the same turnaround times.

title: Test preparation and fasting instructions
text: Please read these instructions before coming for a blood test at Varunika Hospitals. Fasting tests: for fasting blood sugar, lipid profile and all health check packages, Varunika Hospitals requires a strict 12-hour fast before the sample is taken. This applies to every fasting test at our labs, even where other labs ask for 8 hours. If you have fasted for less than 12 hours, the lab will still take the sample but will report the sugar as a random sugar, not a fasting sugar, and you may be asked to come again. Do not fast for more than 14 hours. During the fast you may drink plain water. Do not have tea, coffee, milk, juice, chewing gum, tobacco or pan masala. Medicines: take your usual blood pressure and thyroid medicines with water unless your doctor has told you otherwise. Do not take diabetes tablets or insulin until after the fasting sample; bring them with you. Post-prandial (PP) sugar: the PP sample is taken exactly 2 hours after you start your meal. Tell the collection staff the time you started eating. Do not eat again or have tea during those 2 hours. Urine tests: give the first urine of the morning, midstream, in the sterile container provided by the lab. Ultrasound: ultrasound abdomen needs a 6-hour fast; a pelvic ultrasound needs a full bladder, so drink four to five glasses of water one hour before and do not pass urine. Please bring your doctor's prescription, a photo ID and your previous reports to every test visit.

title: Visiting hours, visitor passes and parking
text: Visiting hours at both Varunika Hospitals branches, all days: general wards and private rooms 11:00 am to 12:00 pm and 5:00 pm to 7:00 pm. ICU, NICU and HDU: 4:00 pm to 4:30 pm only, one visitor at a time, immediate family only. Passes: every admitted patient is given one attendant pass, which allows one person to stay with the patient round the clock, and two visitor passes, which are valid only during visiting hours. Passes must be shown at the lift lobby security desk. A lost attendant pass is replaced at the admissions desk for ₹100. Children: children under 12 are not allowed into wards, private rooms or ICUs at any time, including the maternity ward. Children under 12 can meet a patient only in the family lounge on the ground floor, between 5:00 pm and 6:00 pm, and only if the treating team allows the patient to come down. Infection control: all visitors must use the hand sanitiser at the ward entrance. Flowers and outside food are not allowed in ICUs. Visitors with fever, cough or cold are asked not to visit. Parking at Baner: basement parking for cars is ₹40 for the first 3 hours and ₹20 for every additional hour; two-wheelers pay ₹20 per day. Attendants of admitted patients can buy a car parking pass for ₹150 per day at the admissions desk. Parking at Nashik: open parking inside the campus, free for patients and visitors, subject to space; the gate closes at 11:00 pm.

title: Insurance and TPA cashless desk
text: The insurance and TPA desk handles cashless hospitalisation for patients with health insurance. It is on the ground floor next to Admissions at both Varunika Hospitals branches. Desk hours: Monday to Saturday 8:00 am to 8:00 pm, and Sunday 9:00 am to 2:00 pm. The desk is closed on Sunday afternoons and evenings; emergency admissions at those times are registered by the Admissions desk and the cashless request is sent the next morning. The hospital is empanelled with most major health insurers and TPAs; the current list is displayed at the desk and in the app. Planned admissions: the pre-authorisation request must be submitted at least 72 hours before the planned admission date. Bring the policy card or e-card, a photo ID of the patient, the treating doctor's admission advice with the cost estimate, and previous reports. Emergency admissions: the pre-authorisation request must be submitted within 24 hours of admission. Deposit on cashless: even when a cashless request has been sent, a refundable deposit of ₹10,000 is collected at admission. It is adjusted against non-payable items such as registration, consumables, attendant food and toiletries, and any co-payment or room-rent difference under your policy, which the patient pays at discharge. If the insurer rejects or partly approves the request, the balance must be paid as a self-paying patient. At discharge, the desk sends the final bill to the insurer; final approval usually arrives within 3 hours, and the patient can leave once it is received and the non-payable amount is paid. For reimbursement claims, the desk gives you the original bills and discharge summary.

title: Admission deposits and refunds
text: Self-paying patients pay an advance deposit at the time of admission at either Varunika Hospitals branch. Deposit by room category: general ward ₹20,000; twin sharing room ₹35,000; single room ₹50,000; deluxe room ₹75,000; ICU ₹1,00,000. For planned surgery the deposit is the room deposit or 50% of the surgery estimate, whichever is higher. If the running bill goes above the deposit, the billing team will ask for an interim deposit. Payment modes: UPI, debit card, credit card, NEFT or RTGS, demand draft, and cash up to ₹1,99,999 per admission. Documents: a photo ID of the patient (Aadhaar card, PAN card, passport, voter ID or driving licence) and a photo ID of the relative who signs the admission consent form. For a patient who arrives unconscious, the ID can be submitted within 24 hours. Refund of excess deposit: if the final bill is lower than the deposit, the excess is not paid back in cash at the discharge counter. It is refunded only by bank transfer to the patient's bank account, or to the original card for card payments, within 10 working days of the final bill being settled. Please fill in the refund form and attach a cancelled cheque at the billing counter on the day of discharge; delays in giving bank details will delay the refund. Cashless patients pay a separate refundable deposit, explained in the insurance and TPA desk document.

title: Discharge process
text: Discharge at Varunika Hospitals usually works as follows. The treating doctor decides on discharge during the morning round, and the ward nurse informs the family by 11:00 am. The billing team then prepares the final bill; for self-paying patients this takes about 2 to 3 hours, and for cashless patients it also depends on the insurer's final approval. Room vacating time: the room must be vacated by 2:00 pm on the day of discharge. If the patient leaves the room after 2:00 pm, half a day's room rent is added to the final bill; after 8:00 pm, a full day's room rent is added. The same rule applies to ICU beds. What you receive: two copies of the discharge summary, signed by the treating doctor, along with the final bill, the receipts, all original reports and films, and the take-home medicines from the in-house pharmacy. Please check the medicine list with the nurse before you leave. Unopened take-home medicines can be returned to the pharmacy within 7 days with the bill. Follow-up: the discharge summary gives the date for the follow-up visit, which must be booked through the call centre. Leaving against medical advice: if the family decides to take the patient home before the doctor advises discharge, a relative must sign a discharge against medical advice (DAMA) form. Wheelchairs and help to the car park are available from the ward on request. Discharges are not processed between 10:00 pm and 7:00 am except for a medical emergency transfer.

title: Medical records requests (effective 1 June 2023)
text: This page describes how patients can get copies of their medical records from Varunika Hospitals. Effective 1 June 2023. Requests are made at the Medical Records Department (MRD) at either branch, Monday to Friday, 10:00 am to 5:00 pm, using the records request form. Copies of a complete inpatient case file are ready within 7 working days of the request. The fee is ₹300 per inpatient file, whatever the number of pages. Copies of outpatient prescriptions and lab reports can be downloaded free from the Varunika app. Who can apply: the patient; or another person carrying an authorisation letter signed by the patient, with photo ID copies of both the patient and the person collecting. For a minor, a parent or legal guardian can apply. For a deceased patient, the legal heir can apply with the death certificate and proof of relationship. Courier delivery anywhere in India is available for ₹100 extra. Copies are certified by the MRD officer on each page. Original files are never handed over; they remain with the hospital and are stored for the period required by law. Requests from police, courts and insurers are handled separately by the medico-legal cell. A discharge summary copy is always given free to the patient at the time of discharge, and a duplicate discharge summary costs ₹100 at the MRD.

title: Medical records requests (effective 1 August 2026), replaces the June 2023 version
text: Effective 1 August 2026, this replaces the medical records policy of 1 June 2023. Requests are made at the Medical Records Department (MRD) at either Varunika Hospitals branch, Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am to 4:00 pm, using the records request form, or by email to the MRD with a signed scanned form. Timeline: certified copies of an inpatient case file are released only after 15 working days from the date of the written request. Every file is audited and certified page by page by the MRD before release, and requests cannot be fast-tracked, including for insurance claims; for insurance, the free discharge summary and final bill are normally enough to start a claim. Fee: ₹500 per inpatient file of up to 50 pages, and ₹5 for every page beyond 50. Courier delivery anywhere in India is ₹100 extra. Outpatient prescriptions and lab reports remain free to download from the Varunika app. Who can apply: the patient; or another person carrying an authorisation letter signed by the patient, with photo ID copies of both the patient and the person collecting. The letter must name the person collecting and the admission dates of the file requested. For a minor, a parent or legal guardian can apply. For a deceased patient, the legal heir can apply with the death certificate and proof of relationship. Original files are never handed over. A discharge summary copy is given free at the time of discharge; a duplicate discharge summary costs ₹100 at the MRD.

title: Emergency department, pharmacy and vaccination clinic
text: Emergency: the Emergency departments at both Varunika Hospitals branches are open 24 hours, all days, and do not need an appointment. Patients are seen in order of medical urgency, not arrival time. The emergency consultation fee is ₹1,200 at Baner and ₹1,000 at Nashik, and tests and treatment are billed separately. For non-urgent problems such as a mild fever, a routine prescription refill or a check-up, please use the OPD instead, which is quicker and costs less. Ambulance: call 020 4719 2299. Pharmacy: the pharmacy at Baner is open 24 hours. The pharmacy at Nashik is open 8:00 am to 11:00 pm; at night, medicines for Emergency patients are issued from the emergency stock. Both pharmacies fill outside prescriptions and give a 10% discount on bills above ₹1,000, except on surgical items and baby food. Vaccination clinic: children's vaccinations at Baner are given on Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday, 10:00 am to 1:00 pm; at Nashik on Wednesday and Saturday, 9:30 am to 12:30 pm. No appointment is needed for children's vaccinations, but please bring the child's vaccination card. Adult vaccines (influenza, hepatitis B, HPV, typhoid, pneumococcal) are given by appointment at both branches on weekdays. Vaccines are charged at their printed price plus a ₹150 administration charge per visit. The vaccination clinic is closed on public holidays. Travel vaccines such as yellow fever are not available at either branch.
